content: Tsukʋlɛ Osínpʋ Tsa
Mʋ́ sʋ Yesu léyinkí wíé ɔklʋntɔ, fá ɔpʋ amʋ yɔ́ wúlu amʋ́ʋ́ otsie mʋ́tɔ́ ámʋsʋ
Ɩnʋ á, akʋ bɔsʋrá tsukʋlɛ osínpʋ akpasʋ ba mʋ. Brɛ́á Yesu lówun ánɩ́ bahɔ mʋ gyi a, ɔlɛbláa tsukʋlɛ osínpʋ amʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Mɩ́ bí, klʋn ɩdɩ́ fʋ́ asɩ. Nasí fʋ́ lakpan kíé fʋ́.”
Ɩnʋ Mose mbla asunápʋ́ akʋá bʋtsie ɩnʋ, bɛblɩ́ wá nwuntɔ bɛɛ, “Oyin ánfɩ labɔ́ mbusuo.”
Yesu lɛ́bɩ amʋ́ agywɩɩn. Mʋ́ sʋ ɔlɛfɩtɛ́ amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Ntogyi sʋ́ mlɩdɛ́ ɩ́nɩ odu gywɩɩ́n?
Mɔmʋ bɔ́wa ablɩ́lɛ́ dʋn? ‘Nasí fʋ́ lakpan kíé fʋ́.’ ntɛ́ɛ ‘Kʋsʋ tsu fʋ́ akpa afʋnatɩ?’

Támɛ ndekléá mlɩbɩ́ɩ ánɩ́ mɩ́, Nyankpʋsa-Mʋ-Bi ánfɩ mbʋ túmi ɔyɩ́ ánfɩtɔ sí ahá lakpan kíé amʋ́.” Ɩnʋ ɔlɛbláa tsukʋlɛ osínpʋ amʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Ndɛ fʋ́ bláa mbɛ́ɛ, kʋsʋ. Tsu fʋ́ akpa afʋnatɩ yɔ wóyítɔ́!”
Ɩnʋ ɔlɔkʋsʋ́ nátɩ́ yɔ́ wóyítɔ́.
Ɩ́nɩ lɔ́wa amʋ́ fɛ́ɛ́ wánwan, bɛkanfʋ́ Bulu ánɩ́ alapʋ́ túmiá igyi alɩ há anyánkpʋ́sa.
Mateo Tɩ
Brɛ́á Yesu lɔ́pʋ ɔyɔ́ á, olowun lampóo ɔhɔ́pʋ ɔkʋá bʋtɛtɩ́ mʋ Mateo tsie lampóo ɔhɔ́kpa. Mʋ́ʋ́ ɔlɛbláa mʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Bobuo mɩ.” Ɩnʋnʋ Mateo lɔ́kʋsʋ́ buo mʋ.
Mateo lɛ́tɩ Yesu mʋa mʋ akasɩ́pʋ́ atɔ́ ogyíkpá mʋ wóyítɔ́. Lampóo ahɔ́pʋ pʋ́ lakpan abwɛpʋ́ tsɔtsɔɔtsɔ bɛba atɔ́ ámʋ ogyíkpá.
Farisifɔ ámʋ benya wun amʋ́ alɩ, bɛfɩtɛ́ mʋ akasɩ́pʋ́ amʋ bɛɛ, “Ntogyi sʋ́ mlɩ osunápʋ́ mʋa ahá ánfɩ odu bʋtɔwá ɩbɩ gyi atɔ́?”
Yesu lónu asʋ́n ánfɩ, ɔlɛbláa amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Alɔpʋ léhián ɩlɔ ɔtsapʋ́, megyí ahá ánɩ́ ɩwɩ bʋ amʋ́ ɔnlɩn.
Mlɩyɔ amlɩyɛfɩtɛ́ Bulu asʋ́n ánfɩ bɔwanlɩ́n tswɩ anfɩ asɩ. Bɛɛ, ‘Nwewúun ntekle, megyí igyíha.’ Mmɛba aha wankláán ɔtɩkpá, lakpan abwɛpʋ́ ɔtɩkpá nɛba.”
Ɔnɔ́klɩ́ Ɩwɩ Asʋn Fɩtɛ́hɛ́
Ɛkɛ ɔkʋ Asú Ɔbɔpʋ́ Yohane akasɩ́pʋ́ bɛba Yesu wá bɛfɩtɛ́ mʋ bɛɛ, “Ntogyi sʋ́ anɩa Farisifɔ anɩtɛklɩ́ ɔnɔ́, támɛ fʋ́ akasɩ́pʋ́ mʋ́ bʋtamaklɩ́ ɔnɔ́?”
Yesu lɛ́lɛ mʋ́ ɔnɔ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Ɔtsɩ ɔkpaɩ́npʋ́ anyawíeá bʋbʋ mʋ wá bégyi awɩrɛhɔ? Ɛkɛkɛɛkɛ! Támɛ ɛkɛ kʋ bɛ́ba ánɩ́ bɛ́kpa ɔká otsiápʋ amʋ nátɩ́ sí amʋ́. Alɩ nkɛ ámʋtɔ bɛ́klɩ́ ɔnɔ́ nɩ́.”
“Ɔhaa tamapʋ́ tati pɔpwɛ tan tati dada. Tsúfɛ́ tati pɔpwɛ amʋ bɛ́kpɩkpɩ́ɩ tsií dáda amʋ kʋ lɛ́, há ɔtánkpa ɩnʋ bɛ́latɛ́ɩ́ tsɩ́a.

Alɩ kɛ́n bʋtamapʋ́ nta pɔpwɛ wá ɔwʋlʋ́-kpákpá kɛntɛ wuhɛ́tɔ́ nɩ́. Nta pɔpwɛ amʋ ibófu fá kɛntɛ amʋ, tsítsá, ibéyintá kɛntɛ amʋ ɛ́. Ɩ́nɩ sʋ ɔwʋlʋ́-kpákpá kɛntɛ pɔpwɛtɔ bʋ́tɔpʋ́ nta pɔpwɛ wá, mɛ́nɩ mʋ́ anyɔ ámʋ fɛ́ɛ́ bétsiá.”
Ɔhandɛ Ɔkʋ Mʋ Bi Mʋa Ɔtsɩ Ɔkʋ Ɩlɔ Tsa
Brɛ́á Yesu dɛ́tɔɩ́ á, Yudafɔ ofíakpa ɔhandɛ ɔkʋ lɛ́ba bɛda akpawunu mʋ ayabitɔ, kókóli mʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Mɩ́ bí tsɩ́hɛ́ lawú sésééséi, támɛ ba afʋbɔpʋ ɩbɩ dɩnka mʋsʋ onya nkpa.”
Mʋ́ sʋ Yesu lɔ́kʋsʋ́, mʋa mʋ akasɩ́pʋ́ bobuo ɔhandɛ amʋ.
Ɔtsɩ ɔkʋá obugya dɛ mʋ wʋlɩ́ nfí dúanyɔ nɩ́ lɔ́tsʋn yɔ Yesu ɔma, pʋ́ ɩbɩ da mʋ tati osiebí.
Tsúfɛ́ ɔlɛblɩ́ wá mʋ nwuntɔ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Nɩ́ nɔpʋ́ ɩbɩ da mʋ tati kpán á, ɩlɔ bési mɩ́.”
Yesu lɛ́damlí kɩ mʋ, bláa mʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Mɩ́ bí, klʋn ɩdɩ́ fʋ́ asɩ. Fʋ́ hógyi latsá fʋ́ ɩlɔ.” Ɩnʋnʋ ɔtsɩ ámʋ ɩwɩ lɔ́wa mʋ ɔnlɩn.
Brɛ́á olowie ɔhandɛ amʋ wóyítɔ́ a, olowun ɩkpɛ afʋlɩ́pʋ́, nú awɩrɛhɔ agyípʋ́ amʋ okitikíti.
Olegya amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Mlɩdalɩ nfɩ! Otsibi amʋ mɔ́kʋ́wú, dɩdɩ́ ɔdɛ.” Ahá ámʋ bɔmɔsɩ́ mʋ.
Brɛ́á amʋ́ fɛ́ɛ́ bɛdalɩ ba wunsɩnɛ́sʋ́ a, Yesu lébitíwíé obu ámʋ́ʋ́ otsibi amʋ da mʋ́tɔ́ ámʋtɔ yɛ́kɩtá mʋ ɩbɩ, ɔlɔkʋsʋ́.
Asʋ́n ánfɩ lɛ́klɛɩ́ wá ɔmá ámʋtɔ fɛ́ɛ́.
Ansibi Abwiepʋ́ Ɩlɔ Tsa
Yesu lɛ́dalɩ ɔyɔ́ á, ansibi abwiepʋ́ abanyɔ́ akʋ bobuo mʋ, bʋdɛ okitikíti sʋrá kpólí mʋ bɛɛ, “Owíe Dawid mʋ na, wun anɩ nwɛ!”
Brɛ́á olowie wóyítɔ́ a, ansibi abwiepʋ́ ámʋ bɛba mʋ wá. Yesu lɛ́fɩtɛ́ amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Mlɩlahogyi mlɩaa, nɛ́talɩ́ há mlɩ ansíbi bóbwií?” Bɛlɛ mʋ́ ɔnɔ́ bɛɛ, “Anɩ Wíé, Ee!”
Mʋ́ʋ́ ɔlɔpʋ ɩbɩ dada amʋ́ ansíbi, bláa amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Ɩbá mʋ́tɔ́ ha mlɩ, mlɩ hógyi ɔnɔ́.”
Ɩnʋ bɔwa atɔ́ wun bɩ. Yesu lɛ́da amʋ́ ɔlá ɔbɛ́ɛ, bʋmábláa ɔhaa.
Támɛ brɛ́á bɛdalɩ bɔyɔ́ á, bɛda mʋ ɔkan ɔmá ámʋ fɛ́ɛ́tɔ́.
Omúmu Ɩlɔ Tsa
Benya nátɩ́ alɩ, bɔpʋ oyin ɔkʋá ɔŋɛ laláhɛ bʋ mʋtɔ, sʋ alatɔ́ omúmu ba Yesu.
Olenya gya ɔŋɛ laláhɛ amʋ lɛ́ oyin ámʋtɔ alɩ, ɔlɔwa tɔɩ́ bɩ. Ahá ámʋ fɛ́ɛ́ bowun, sʋ ɔnɔ́ lobwie amʋ́. Mʋ́ sʋ bɛblɩ́ bɛɛ, “Anɩmɔ́kʋ́wun ɩ́nɩ odu Israelfɔtɔ kɩ!”
Farisifɔ ámʋ bɛblɩ́ bɛɛ, “Ɔŋɛ laláhɛ owíe túmi ɔdɛpʋgya ɔŋɛ laláhɛ lɛ́ ahátɔ.”
Ahá Nwewúun
Yesu léki awúlu pʋ́ nkuda fɛ́ɛ́ asɩ, súná atɔ́ Yudafɔ ofíakpa. Ɔlɛda Bulu iwíegyí ámʋ ɩwɩ asʋn wankláán ɔkan. Ɔlɛtsa ɩlɔ kugyíkʋ fɛ́ɛ́.
Brɛ́á olowun ɔdɔm amʋ a, amʋ́ asʋ́n lɔ́wa mʋ nwɛ. Bʋgyi fɛ́ akúfa ánɩ́ bʋma ɔkpapʋ́, tsúfɛ́ asʋ́n dɛ amʋ́ háan, bʋma tɔtɔ bwɛtɔ́.
Mʋ́ sʋ ɔlɛbláa mʋ akasɩ́pʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Atɔ kpɔtɩ́hɛ́ amʋ ɩtsɔ, támɛ mʋ́ akpɔtɩ́pʋ́ bʋmɔtsɔ́.
Mʋ́ sʋ mlɩkokoli ndɔ mʋ wie, ɔwa atɔ́ akpɔtɩ́pʋ́ tsɔtsɔ abʋba bɔkpɔtɩ́ atɔ́ ámʋ.”
